citations.long: The quality control unit lacks the responsibility and authority to reject all drug products.

citations.short: Authority lacking to review records, investigate errors
citations.long: The quality control unit lacks authority to fully investigate errors that have occurred.

citations.short: Approve or reject procedures or specs
citations.long: The quality control unit lacks responsibility to approve and reject all procedures or specifications impacting on the identity, strength, quality, and purity of drug products.
Equipment and utensils are not cleaned at appropriate intervals to prevent contamination that would alter the safety, identity, strength, quality or purity of the drug product.

citations.short: Quarantine of Rejected Components et. al.
citations.long: Rejected closures are not controlled under a quarantine system designed to prevent their use in manufacturing or processing operations for which they are unsuitable.

citations.short: Control procedures to monitor and validate performance
citations.long: Control procedures are not established which monitor the output and validate the performance of those manufacturing processes that may be responsible for causing variability in the characteristics of in-process material and the drug product.
Procedures designed to prevent objectionable microorganisms in drug products not required to be sterile are not established.
Deviations from written specifications and test procedures are not recorded and justified.
Established laboratory control mechanisms are not followed and documented at the time of performance.
Procedures for the preparation of master production and control records are not described in a written procedure.

citations.short: Quality control unit review of records
citations.long: Drug product production and control records, are not reviewed by the quality control unit to determine compliance with all established, approved written procedures before a batch is released or distributed.
Written records of investigations into the failure of a batch or any of its components to meet specifications do not always include the conclusions and follow-up.

citations.short: Complaints reviewed by Quality Control Unit
citations.long: Written procedures describing the handling of complaints do not include provisions for review by the quality control unit of any complaint involving the possible failure of a drug product to meet any of its specifications and a determination as to the need for an investigation of any unexplained discrepancy.

citations.short: Written complaint record  to be maintained at facility
citations.long: A written record of each complaint is not maintained in a file designated for drug product complaints at the facility where the drug product was manufactured, processed or packed.
